question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given

Baker's Dozen

options.text: One unit extra with one dozen

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"Baker's Dozen"** refers to a group of thirteen items, specifically one more than a standard dozen (12). It originated from historical practices where bakers would include an extra item to avoid penalties for selling underweight goods. (बेकरी की दर्जन यानी तेरह)

 
 
• **Example:** A baker’s dozen of cookies means you get thirteen cookies instead of twelve.
 
 
 
• The correct word here refers to the concept of including one extra unit with a dozen. (तेरह का समूह)
 
 
• **Example:** When ordering a baker's dozen of donuts, you would receive thirteen donuts.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct meaning of "Baker's Dozen" is "One unit extra with one dozen".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Choosing quality over quantity** (गुणवत्ता को मात्रा पर प्राथमिकता देना): This refers to prioritizing the quality of items rather than their quantity.

 
 
• **Example:** She believes in choosing quality over quantity when buying clothes.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A pile of bread** (ब्रेड का ढेर): This refers to a stack or collection of bread, which is not related to the term "Baker's Dozen".
 
 
• **Example:** The baker prepared a pile of bread for the morning rush.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: When shopkeepers put something extra** (जब दुकानदार कुछ अतिरिक्त देते हैं): This could be related but is less specific than the correct answer.
 
 
• **Example:** Some shopkeepers add a little extra to build customer loyalty.
 
 

1c6:Ta2c,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
